snippet.title: Live out your dream | OneState Global Launch
snippet.description:
Los Angeles is where you can go to become someone - a place where the American Dream still exists. Starting from the bottom, being happy with just table scraps. It’s important to remember where you came from. Just never lose sight of where you’re going.

OneState’s journey is the same. We started small, but we’re getting bigger and better every day. We’ve expanded our map and increased its level of detail. We’ve listened to what our players want, and we’ve delivered by providing additional servers, increased server capacity, and tons of new features.

We’ve got lots more in store for our hungry fans following our Global Launch on April 9th, as well as tons of features in active development that we can’t wait for you to see.

OneState is forging ahead with our future - will you be there to join us?
